candidates.source_name: Amrop Slovakia – News & Insights
candidates.why_relevant: Largest executive search firm in Slovakia by filled senior positions; publishes market commentary, leadership-succession insight and placement/ranking news that signals which C-level functions banks are building.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: periodic HTML crawl of the SK news-insights listing; extract title/date/summary
queries_used: Amrop Slovensko executive search finančný sektor obsadenie pozície

candidates.source_name: Amrop Slovensko legacy site – articles (amrop.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Older Slovak-language article archive of Amrop SK with thought-leadership on management hiring practices; useful for historical baseline of search-firm commentary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: one-off archival crawl; check whether domain redirects to amrop.com
queries_used: Amrop Slovensko executive search finančný sektor obsadenie pozície

candidates.source_name: Stanton Chase – Financial Services / FinTech practice
candidates.why_relevant: Global retained search firm covering CEE financial services and fintech; publishes sector leadership reports and consultant commentary. SK mandates appear to be served from regional offices (Prague/Vienna) rather than a confirmed Bratislava office.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: crawl practice + insights pages, filter for Slovakia/CEE mentions
queries_used: Stanton Chase Bratislava financial services executive search Slovakia

candidates.source_name: Hays Slovakia employer profile on Profesia.sk
candidates.why_relevant: Live listing of roles Hays Slovakia is mandated to fill, including its Hays Banking and Hays Finance & Accounting divisions — a direct read on which banking/payments functions are being staffed via intermediaries.
candidates.legal_status: public listings; ToS restrict bulk scraping — check robots.txt
candidates.suggested_collection_method: polite scheduled scrape of the agency's employer page; store title, location, posting date
candidates.discovered_via_method: en/sk web search + snowball from Hays
queries_used: hays.sk Slovensko pobočka OR "Hays Slovakia" recruitment banking jobs

candidates.source_name: Hays Salary Guide / Mzdový průzkum (CZ-SK regional)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual salary benchmark covering ~400 roles across 12 specializations incl. banking and finance; the CZ entity also covers Slovak/CEE business-services and banking recruitment, so it is the accessible proxy for Hays SK benchmarks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: annual manual download of the guide PDF; monitor cloud.email.hays.com landing page for new editions
queries_used: Hays Slovensko platový prieskum 2026 bankovníctvo mzdy

candidates.source_name: Grafton Slovakia – Mediálna zóna / tlačové správy
candidates.why_relevant: Grafton runs the largest Slovak private-sector salary survey (360 positions across 8 industries, regional breakdowns) and issues frequent press releases on candidate behaviour, offer-rejection rates and scarce skills — a leading indicator of talent tightness in finance/IT.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/HTML monitor of press-release list; annual capture of the Grafton mzdový prieskum
queries_used: Grafton Slovakia prieskum trhu práce mzdy financie report

candidates.source_name: Gi Group Slovakia (parent of Grafton SK) – insights
candidates.why_relevant: Parent group republishes and extends Grafton's SK labour-market analysis; sometimes carries commentary not on grafton.sk.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML crawl of news/blog section
queries_used: Grafton Slovakia prieskum trhu práce mzdy financie report

candidates.source_name: ManpowerGroup Slovensko – Index trhu práce (MEOS)
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly employer hiring-intent survey with sector cuts (incl. finance/real-estate); Slovakia has been in the panel since 2011, giving a long comparable series on net hiring outlook — a leading indicator of headcount plans at banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: quarterly scrape of the magazín section for MEOS Qx posts; parse sector table
queries_used: ManpowerGroup Slovensko prieskum náboru zamestnanosti MEOS tlačová správa

candidates.source_name: Lugera Slovakia – blog and 30-year market commentary
candidates.why_relevant: Long-established SK recruitment firm (founded Trenčín 1996, permanent placement + executive search); blog carries market/recruitment-trend commentary and its Slovak Spectator profile gives corporate background.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: low-frequency blog crawl; supplement with lugera.com SK job listings
queries_used: Talentuch Lugera Iventa Slovensko recruitment banking fintech blog

candidates.source_name: Talentuch – recruitment blog
candidates.why_relevant: IT/RPO recruiter with Slovak roots; blog covers IT talent supply (SAP, MS Dynamics) relevant to bank/payments technology hiring, though not banking-specific.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: low-frequency blog crawl with keyword filter (bank, fintech, payments)
queries_used: Talentuch Lugera Iventa Slovensko recruitment banking fintech blog

candidates.source_name: Profesia – Najzamestnávateľ (Employer of the Year) results
candidates.why_relevant: Annual employer-attractiveness poll run by Profesia with a dedicated Banking/Insurance/Auditing category; results and participant statements expose self-reported headcount, benefits and structure at VÚB, Slovenská sporiteľňa, NBS, Partners Group etc.

queries_used: "Profesia days" 2026 Bratislava veľtrh práce zamestnávatelia banky

candidates.source_name: Firma Profesia – aktuality (employer-side HR insight)
candidates.why_relevant: Profesia's B2B channel publishes labour-market statistics derived from the dominant SK job portal (offer volumes, response rates, scarce roles) — the closest thing to an index of SK hiring demand, segmentable by sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: monthly crawl of aktuality; extract stats and sector mentions

candidates.source_name: HRhub.sk – Slovak HR knowledge hub and events
candidates.why_relevant: HR-industry media/community: speaker line-ups and case studies name HR directors and transformation projects at Slovak banks, pointing to reorganisations before they are announced publicly.

queries_used: HR magazín Slovensko "personálny manažment" médiá hrhub OR "HR Alert" OR profesia blog trh práce

candidates.source_name: TREND konferencie – HR manažment conference series
candidates.why_relevant: Business-media conference organiser; the HR manažment editions list speakers by name and employer, a reliable way to track who currently runs HR at Slovak banks and insurers and what change programmes they present.

queries_used: HR magazín Slovensko "personálny manažment" médiá hrhub OR "HR Alert" OR profesia blog trh práce

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Stanton Chase office in Bratislava/Slovakia surfaced in either sk or en searches; nearest listed CEE offices are Prague, Vienna and Belgrade.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak mandates appear to be served regionally; no SK-specific Stanton Chase publication channel identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids creating a phantom SK source; SK signals from Stanton Chase must be filtered out of regional/global content.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Hays Slovakia salary guide (hays.sk) was found; Slovak coverage appears folded into the Hays Czech Republic mzdový průzkum and CEE business-services teams.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only hays.cz salary-guide assets and a Hays Slovakia employer page on profesia.sk were located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK banking pay benchmarks from Hays must be sourced from a CZ-branded, registration-gated publication, with caution about country mix.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Slovak for explicit placement announcements ('obsadenie pozície', 'úspešne obsadená pozícia') by SK search firms returned no systematic announcement feed — SK executive search firms rarely publish named placements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Firms publish rankings, sector pages and thought leadership instead of named placements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection in SK must lean on media, LinkedIn and company press rooms rather than search-firm announcements.

negative_findings.description: Searches did not surface an active Iventa Slovakia presence or SK-language content for Iventa within this cell's queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Iventa appears mainly as an AT/CEE brand in results; no SK banking-relevant publication found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed actor list should be corrected rather than assumed live in SK.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SK-owned executive search boutiques (TARGET Executive Search, Personality Group, Perfect Personal, Jenewein/Talentor-type players) were only glimpsed via directories, not individually profiled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl greenpages.sk and the Index SME ranking to enumerate them, then assess each firm's insights/news channel separately.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — where SK recruiters actually post mandates, placements and market commentary — was not queried, and is the single richest intermediary channel for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a compliant LinkedIn monitoring approach (company pages of Amrop SK, Grafton SK, Hays, Manpower SK, plus named consultants) respecting ToS.

coverage_gaps.description: Employer-branding awards beyond Najzamestnávateľ (e.g. Via Bona, AmCham/BSCC employer recognitions, Great Place to Work SK) were not checked for banking participants.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sk-language sweep on 'zamestnávateľ roka', 'Great Place to Work Slovensko', 'employer branding ocenenie banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: The authoritative SK executive-search ranking (Index/SME) is behind a partial paywall, so firm-level placement volumes could not be extracted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Consider an SME/Index subscription or obtain the printed Kariéra Guide edition.

brief: Slovakia's hiring intermediaries publish plenty about the market but almost nothing about individual placements: Amrop (ranked largest by Index/SME), Grafton/Gi Group, ManpowerGroup SK and Hays (via its Czech salary guide and its Profesia.sk employer page) are the productive direct sources, offering salary benchmarks, quarterly hiring-intent indices and candidate-behaviour commentary that flag which banking and IT functions are tight. Employer-side signals come mainly from Profesia's ecosystem — the Najzamestnávateľ award with its dedicated banking/insurance category, the Profesia Days exhibitor roster, and firma.profesia.sk job-portal analytics — supplemented by HR-industry venues (HRhub.sk, TREND HR manažment conferences) whose speaker lists name bank HR leaders and their change programmes. Pointer layers (Index SME rankings, greenpages.sk, personalneagentury.sk) are the fastest route to a complete actor map including SK-owned boutiques not covered here. The main structural gaps are LinkedIn (untouched, and where recruiters actually talk), the paywalled Index ranking, and the absence of any named-placement feed in Slovak, which forces leadership-move detection onto media and company press rooms instead.
